actions.script: let found = null tablesError = null try { found = ec.service.sync().name('org.moqui.dev.DatabaseServices.get#TableStats').parameters({db}).call() } catch (e) { tablesError = String(e.message || e) } if (ec.message.hasError()) { tablesError = ec.message.errorsString; ec.message.clearErrors() } if (!tablesError && found && found.reason) tablesError = found.reason const mib = (bytes) => bytes == null || bytes === '' ? null : Number(bytes) / 1048576 const time = (value) => value == null || value === '' ? '' : ec.l10n.format(basicConvert(value, 'Timestamp'), null) const filter = String(context.tableFilter || '').toLowerCase() tableList = ((found && found.tables) || []).map((table) => ({tableName: table.table_name, entityName: table.entity_name || '', estimatedRows: table.estimated_rows == null ? null : Number(table.estimated_rows), totalMib: mib(table.total_bytes), tableMib: mib(table.table_bytes), indexMib: mib(table.index_bytes), deadRows: table.dead_rows == null ? null : Number(table.dead_rows), freeMib: mib(table.free_bytes), lastVacuum: time(table.last_vacuum || table.last_autovacuum), lastAnalyze: time(table.last_analyze || table.last_autoanalyze), updated: time(table.update_time)})) .filter((table) => !filter || (table.tableName + ' ' + table.entityName).toLowerCase().includes(filter)) isMysql = ((found && found.tables) || []).some((table) => table.engine != null || table.free_bytes != null) maintenanceOptions = isMysql ? [{key: 'analyze', text: 'Analyze (ANALYZE TABLE)'}, {key: 'optimize', text: 'Optimize (OPTIMIZE TABLE)'}] : [{key: 'vacuumAnalyze', text: 'Vacuum and analyze'}, {key: 'analyze', text: 'Analyze'}, {key: 'reindex', text: 'Reindex online'}, {key: 'vacuumFull', text: 'Vacuum full: rewrites the table, locked meanwhile'}, {key: 'cluster', text: 'Cluster: rewrites the table, locked meanwhile'}] canMaintain = ec.user.hasPermission('DATABASE_ADMIN')
